verdict.rationale: A hands-on community benchmark shows Ollama running a Qwen model in q4_K_M (GGUF), nvfp4, and int4 variants via `ollama run`, so some 4-bit quantized formats load. No first-party documentation describes supported quantization formats, and nothing shows FP8, GPTQ, or AWQ models loading. missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization formats, evidence of FP8 support, evidence of GPTQ support, evidence of AWQ support, guidance on importing externally quantized checkpoints.
